instruction: Set VLC's recording path to /home/user/Videos so that all recordings are stored in the Videos folder.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VLC's recording folder path to /home/user/Videos. The evaluator checks the VLC config file (vlcrc) for the setting 'input-record-path=/home/user/Videos'. Uses existing getter 'get_vlc_config' and metric 'is_vlc_recordings_folder'. The task is similar in complexity to the original - a simple settings change.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Binary: 1.0 if input-record-path is set to /home/user/Videos, 0.0 otherwise
